review: Ticket 06: the sole compiled main accepts exactly one .ts filename. It builds a fixed Program without parsing options/configuration, rejects additional Program SourceFiles before queries, calls diagnostics and a borrowed Checker only, and encodes JSON to stdout. It does not call Program.Emit, invoke a subprocess, or load a JS engine. No runtime fallback is expressible. NoEmit is fixed by the callee, and iovfs.From(os.DirFS(cwd)) has no WritableFS; compiler writes are unsupported. Necessary printer/emitter package files remain compiled dependencies. Re-review this boundary if the exact fork changes.
